summary: Where your website lives, what renews when, and who owns what.
content:
You own your domain, your website and your content. This page records where they all are, in case you ever need them.

| Service | Company | Renews | Billed to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Domain name | Northlight Domains | March 14 | Copper Thistle |
| Website hosting | Northlight Hosting | June 1 | Copper Thistle |
| Website license | Total CMS | June 1 | Copper Thistle |
| Email | Your email provider | Monthly | Copper Thistle |

Please keep the card on these accounts up to date. If the domain lapses, your website and email both stop working.

## Listings you manage

- **Google Business Profile:** your hours, photos and reviews on Google Search and Maps
- **OpenTable:** reservations and your hours for booking
- **Instagram and Facebook:** your social accounts

When your hours change, update these as well as [telling me](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/holiday-hours-and-closures).

## Passwords

I never put passwords on this page, and please don't email them. Your logins are in your password manager. If you can't find one, call me.
title: Accounts and renewals
author: Sam Keller
